definition: a school or college for specialized training, or a society of scholars
example: She was accepted into a prestigious academy for the arts.

definition: to change something slightly to make it more suitable
example: Employees had to adjust to working from home during the pandemic.

definition: to change or make something different
example: New evidence altered the researchers' original conclusions.

definition: to make minor changes to a law or document to improve it
example: The committee voted to amend the proposal before it was approved.

definition: having knowledge or perception of a situation or fact
example: More consumers are becoming aware of the environmental impact of fast fashion.

definition: the maximum amount something can contain or produce, or the ability to do something
example: The hospital is operating at full capacity during the flu season.

definition: a difficult task or situation that tests someone's ability
example: Balancing work and family life remains a major challenge for many parents.

definition: a distinct section of a legal document or contract
example: The contract includes a clause allowing early termination.

definition: to make a problem worse by adding to it
example: The economic crisis was compounded by a sharp rise in unemployment.

definition: a serious disagreement or clash
example: Work-related conflict often arises from poor communication.

definition: to seek information or advice from someone
example: Patients should consult a doctor before starting any new medication.

definition: communication or connection with someone
example: Regular contact with family can improve the well-being of elderly people.

definition: to gradually decrease in quantity or quality
example: Birth rates have declined steadily in many developed countries.

definition: individually separate and distinct
example: The training program is divided into several discrete modules.

definition: a preliminary version of a piece of writing
example: She sent the first draft of her essay to her teacher for feedback.

definition: to give someone the ability or means to do something
example: Online learning enables students in remote areas to access quality education.

definition: power derived from resources to provide light, heat, or drive machinery
example: Countries are investing heavily in clean energy sources.

definition: to make sure a law or rule is obeyed
example: It can be difficult to enforce speed limits in rural areas.

definition: a distinct and independent unit or organization
example: Each department operates as a separate legal entity within the company.

definition: equal in value, amount, or meaning
example: A university degree is often seen as equivalent to several years of work experience.

definition: to develop gradually over time
example: Workplace culture has evolved significantly since the introduction of remote work.

definition: to become or make larger in size or scope
example: The company plans to expand its operations into new markets.

definition: to make something known, or to put someone at risk of something harmful
example: Children exposed to reading at an early age often perform better academically.

definition: coming from or existing outside something
example: The company hired an external consultant to review its finances.

definition: to make an action or process easier
example: Technology has facilitated communication between people in different countries.

definition: forming a necessary base or core; essential
example: Access to clean water is a fundamental human right.

definition: to produce or bring something into existence
example: Solar panels generate electricity without producing harmful emissions.

definition: a group of people born around the same time
example: The younger generation is generally more comfortable with technology.

definition: an impression of something, or a visual representation
example: Advertising plays a major role in shaping a brand's public image.

definition: open to new ideas, or favoring individual freedom
example: The country adopted more liberal immigration policies in recent years.

definition: an official document giving permission to do something
example: Drivers must obtain a licence before operating a vehicle.

definition: reasoning conducted according to strict principles of validity
example: There is a certain logic behind raising taxes on unhealthy products.

definition: an amount by which something is won or falls short, or the edge of a page
example: The company's profit margin narrowed due to rising costs.

definition: relating to the treatment of illness or injury
example: Medical costs remain a major concern for uninsured families.

definition: relating to the mind
example: Employers are paying more attention to employees' mental health.

definition: to make partial changes to something
example: The recipe was modified slightly to reduce the amount of sugar.

definition: to observe and check something over a period of time
example: Doctors closely monitor patients with chronic conditions.

definition: a group of interconnected people, systems, or organizations
example: A strong professional network can help graduates find their first job.

definition: a general idea or belief
example: The notion that money guarantees happiness has been widely challenged.

definition: a goal or aim
example: The company's main objective this year is to expand into overseas markets.

definition: to align or position something in relation to a particular direction or purpose
example: The course is oriented toward practical, job-related skills.

definition: a particular way of viewing or considering something
example: Travelling abroad can give people a broader perspective on other cultures.

definition: exact and accurate
example: It is difficult to give a precise figure for how many people work remotely.

definition: of first importance; main
example: Traffic congestion is a prime example of a problem caused by urbanization.

definition: the scientific study of the human mind and behavior
example: Understanding consumer psychology helps companies market their products effectively.

definition: to continue working toward a goal, or to follow a course of action
example: More students are choosing to pursue vocational training instead of university.

definition: the relationship between two amounts, expressed as one number divided by another
example: The student-to-teacher ratio has a direct effect on the quality of education.

definition: to refuse to accept or consider something
example: The proposal was rejected due to a lack of funding.

definition: not likely to change or fail; steady
example: A stable income allows families to plan for the future with confidence.

definition: a distinctive manner or way of doing something
example: Teaching style has a significant impact on how well students learn.

definition: a person or thing used in place of another
example: Video calls are not always a good substitute for face-to-face meetings.

definition: to keep something going over time, or to support something
example: The economy needs new industries to sustain long-term growth.

definition: a sign or object that represents an idea
example: For many people, home ownership is seen as a symbol of success.

definition: an objective or result that a plan is intended to achieve
example: The government set a target to cut carbon emissions by 2030.

definition: the process of traveling or transporting people or goods
example: Investment in public transit can help reduce traffic congestion in cities.

definition: a general direction in which something is developing
example: There is a growing trend toward remote and flexible working arrangements.

definition: a particular form of something that differs from other forms
example: The updated version of the app includes several new safety features.

definition: the health, happiness, and well-being of a person or group, or government support for those in need
example: The company introduced new policies to improve employee welfare.

definition: in contrast to the fact that; while
example: City residents often rely on public transport, whereas rural residents depend on cars.
